description:
Search 2,876 published SIIL Ostomy daily-life, recovery, sleep, shower, sport & intimacy guides across 20 languages.

    Args:
        query: Search query in any of the 20 languages (e.g. en, en-gb, es, fr, de, it, pl, nl, sv, da, nb, fi, cs, sk, hu, ro, el, pt, hr, ja).
        lang: Optional language code (en, en-gb, es, fr, de, it, pl, ja, cs, sk, sv, da, nb, fi, nl, pt, hu, ro, el, hr).
        country: Optional 2-letter ISO country code (US, GB, ES, FR, DE, IT, PL...).
        topic: Optional topic id (hiding-the-bag, clothing, swimwear-water, travel, sport-active, intimacy, recovery, support-confidence, everyday-life, basics, health-info).
        limit: Max results (1-10, default 5).
name: search_guides
